analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price (114,400 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (108,959 KRW / 107,623 KRW / 106,718 KRW): Short/mid-term trend above, mid-long-term trend neutral.
· Position vs SMA100/200 (142,447 KRW / 107,669 KRW): Below mid-long-term trend, indicating neutral range.
· 52-week Position (38.3%) + Current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (43.4 → 54.5): Exited oversold, entered neutral zone, confirming upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (502.3639 → 1247.3304): Continued improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band 107,623 KRW): Bandwidth at 19.83% suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (98,695 KRW): Based on Pivot S1 (99,300 KRW) and 20-day low (94,590 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (115,010 KRW): Approaching Pivot R1 (124,790 KRW) and 5-day high (120,080 KRW).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Patterns (Consolidation): Absence of clear Higher Low or Lower High patterns.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.05x): Normal level, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Maintain wait-and-see; consider buying on breakout above 115,010 KRW.
